Back in the tower, by the sputtering hiss of the mantle lamp, he drew the paper out with tweezers. Thomas looked up at the stone walls, then out at the black sea, where the light swept its blind circle across the dark.", "w02": "四点的钟声隐在薄雾里，城市还未从长夜中醒来。路灯将潮湿的柏油路面拉得极长，偶尔有运菜的货车沉闷地驶过，打破了黎明前的寂静。空气里带着江水的潮气和早市豆浆的微香，远处的霓虹灯牌疲惫地闪烁着最后几秒微光。在这个间隙里，世界像是属于几个孤单的步行者，连呼吸都格外清晰。", "w03": "- First, you write a task that can be broken down into smaller pieces of the exact same kind.\n- Second, you make sure there is a simple stopping point so the repetition does not go on forever.\n- Third, you watch the process call itself over and over until it reaches the end and builds the answer back up."}
